_comment: SIGNAL 45 canonical stock-resource and needs values (vertical slice). PROVISIONAL until first-playable measurement (D-043). Single source of truth for stock/needs numbers: docs cite this file; survival_model.py loads it (utility numbers: utilities.json; incident/condition/HIGHBALL numbers: incidents.json). Keys under 'model_unconsumed' annotations are architecture-only and consumed by no slice code (D-045).

spoilage.rule: forecast-only in slice: perishables from runs must be eaten within 2 days or convert to 50% stable rations; no silent loss
spoilage._note: architecture defined, not modeled in the slice simulation (D-045); slice_active flips at first playable

contamination.effect: tank flagged: boil order or medicine risk; supply link named in warning (numbers: incidents.json water_contamination)

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.rules: consumed when treatment begins (committed at triage); never passively lost; no expiration in slice

materials.name: Materials
materials.note: the labor model (simulate_vertical_slice.py START_SALVAGE) owns the authoritative materials ledger and constant; test_survival_model.py asserts the two 12s agree so they cannot silently diverge
materials.reservation: reserved at project confirmation; consumed at completed stages; unconsumed reserve refunds 100%; deconstruction recovers 50% of consumed materials, once per installed component (no loops)
materials.reservation_model_status: design rule — stated here, enforced by the reservation system at first playable; the slice simulation does not model cancel/deconstruct arithmetic (D-045)

charge.name: Charge
charge.note: the Fuel role of the canonical set (D-043): stored energy powering defined equipment; the Flywheel is the producer, the load board names every consumer

item_families._comment: Layer 3 architecture. Detailed recipes are the crafting stage's work; the HUD 'Materials' chip expands to show family availability per project.
item_families.slice_deferred_note: deferred families exist as fiction and loadout flags in the slice (masks/protective gear resolve as run-provisioning flags, not stock); filters gate the full game's replacement orders — the slice's air incidents cost Materials + WU and say so (D-045)
item_families.project_block_rule: a blocked project names the missing family, never just 'not enough Materials'

condition_states_note: equipment condition vocabulary; filters additionally use 'clogged' as their worn-state name (18 §3)

needs.scale: 0-100; hunger/fatigue/stress higher is worse; health higher is better
needs.death_rule: slice: no death; critical health auto-pauses and forces the emergency card; full game: death requires an existing serious condition + warning + response window + a deliberate high-risk choice
